execution: shadow_replay_or_paper_only; schedules nothing and sends no broker orders
evaluation_window_policy: Use the declared available window with all eligible sessions. No fixed future-session count is a completion condition. Report sample size, dependence, every reporting endpoint and inconclusive evidence explicitly.
independence: The 156-session selection window is reused development evidence. Independent evaluation requires observations unavailable to all upstream strategy and allocation selections; relabeling an old split is insufficient.
books: KALCB sizing 2 with native physical leverage 2
comparison_contract: Identical dates, market/candidate vintages, cost and participation assumptions. Separate executable accounts; no addition of mutually infeasible trade PnL.
fixed: native strategy settings and candidate availability rules
baseline, cost, participation and combined stress definitions
observations: every native decision and generated intent, with timestamp and immutable feature/source identity
native KALCB submission, OLR allocated quantity, reservation and rejection/resize reason
actual fills, residual orders, funding, cash and marked exposure
completed lifecycles, economically meaningful ticket counts, turnover and active sessions
all missing feeds, stale observations, execution failures and required management sessions
shadow_labels: Never-admitted opportunities require their own causal native exit lifecycle and explicit feasible capacity assumptions before they can train a ranker. Keep shadow outcomes separate; never credit them to the realized portfolio.
evaluation: incremental baseline and stressed net return versus every feasible matched standalone
marked intraday DD, worst session, expected shortfall, overnight exposure and concentration
trade count, ticket-size distribution, capital-time use and active sessions
sleeve PnL, changes to KALCB opportunity retention, and return concentration
paired five-session block bootstrap with 5000 resamples and seed 20261008, disclosed as descriptive only

review_triggers.meaning: Research review triggers, not newly simulated stop/liquidation rules or future loss guarantees.

integrity_failures: funding or admission exposure beyond verified account capacity
KALCB overnight residual or unresolved terminal positions/orders
retuning: A change creates a separately registered experiment. Keep the preceding profile and evidence immutable.
decision: Implementation completion is separate from independent performance and broker readiness. No automatic deployment. Live use requires a separately documented operational decision and verified broker funding/order parity.
